name: SSHI_HalfBridge
rationale: This is a variation of the SSHI topology using a half-bridge rectifier instead of a full-bridge. In some conditions (like S3 with strong excitation), a full bridge might push Vout above 5.5V. A half-bridge reduces the average current flowing into Cout, which can help keep the voltage within the absolute maximum range while still benefiting from the SSHI voltage boost to meet the minimum supply requirements.
